title: Towards Measuring the Representation of Subjective Global Opinions in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering cross-national multiple-choice survey questions (from the Pew Global Attitudes Survey and World Values Survey) to an LLM and calculating the similarity between the model's predicted probability distributions and human response distributions conditioned on specific countries. The study also utilizes cross-national prompting (asking the model to respond as a person from a specific country) to evaluate the model's reliance on cultural stereotypes.

Translating the survey questions into target languages (Russian, Chinese, and Turkish) using a linguistic prompting condition to measure whether these linguistic cues successfully shift the model's generated responses to align more closely with the opinions of the populations that predominantly speak those languages.
